title: No Need For Real Anomaly: MLLM Empowered Zero-Shot Video Anomaly Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of an anomaly detection framework using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While it identifies certain negative behaviors (such as 'intentional injury' or 'abuse') as anomalies, it does so for computer vision classification rather than to evaluate or benchmark ethics, religion, or moral philosophy.
